name: Triuggio (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Triuggio (a chevron and doves on blue) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI TRIUGGIO in black arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Triuggio, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Triuggio arms — chevron and doves on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI TRIUGGIO arched above the arms
